provenance.annotation_scope: Offline catalogs restricted to gene/feature IDs in the supplied CCLE three-view teaching pools. Retain every term having at least one supplied member; no enrichment-dependent term selection.

gene_ontology.method: GOALL inherited Biological Process annotations; union of supplied protein and RNA gene symbols. No enrichment-dependent term selection.

reactome.processing: Human R-HSA pathways only; retain gene-symbol members overlapping the union of supplied protein/RNA teaching pools.

kegg.name_matching: Strict normalized source-name to KEGG synonym matching, plus3 explicit curated acid/base or word-order synonyms. Normalization does not drop L/D/R/S labels. Multiple compound matches, isomer mixtures and sum-composition lipids are excluded. Names alone are not a new analytical identity confirmation.
kegg.pathway_membership: Official compound→reference pathway links, restricted to maps with human pathway counterparts. This is reference-map membership, not a reconstruction of human-specific reactions. Exclude map011xx/map012xx broad overview maps.
kegg.limitations: Many aminoacid source names lack stereochemistry; matching generic KEGG entries may have no pathway link. They are not silently converted into L-amino acids. Unknown or ambiguous IDs must not be treated as absent metabolites.

provenance.background_guidance: For each view and run, intersect the actual model-feature IDs with the union of the selected catalog memberships. Query is top-loading features intersect that same background; deduplicate IDs. Test all eligible terms, then BH-adjust within that view/catalog/factor/sign selection. Report measured/mapped background and query counts.
